scripts.dev: npm run build -w @medtime/shared && concurrently -k -n server,client "npm run dev -w @medtime/server" "npm run dev -w @medtime/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @medtime/shared && npm run build -w @medtime/server && npm run build -w @medtime/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @medtime/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @medtime/shared && npm run test -w @medtime/server
scripts.seed: npm run build -w @medtime/shared && npm run seed -w @medtime/server
